test_title: PYST 5: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 29 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Change the following from active to passive:

They will have finalized the agenda by tomorrow morning.

options.text: The agenda had been finalized by them.
The agenda was finalized by them.
The agenda will have been finalized by tomorrow morning.
The agenda will be finalized tomorrow.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence is in the **Future Perfect tense** in the active voice ("**will have finalized**").
 
• To convert Future Perfect from active to passive, the structure used is: **Object + will have + been + past participle (V3) + by + Subject**.
 
• The object "**the agenda**" becomes the new subject, and "**will have finalized**" changes to "**will have been finalized**."
 
• Option 3 is the only choice that maintains the correct tense and follows the passive voice formula for the future perfect.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The **agenda will have been finalized** by tomorrow morning."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (Past Perfect Passive):** "had been finalized" is used when the original sentence is in the past perfect tense.
 
• **Option 2 (Simple Past Passive):** "was finalized" is used for converting sentences originally in the simple past tense.
 
• **Option 4 (Simple Future Passive):** "will be finalized" is the passive form for the simple future ("will finalize").
